intents.title: Run afwe sync in CI to materialize derived state before check
intents.description: Because derived index and state are deliberately excluded from git (.gitignore), a fresh CI checkout starts with never_synced. In CI, run afwe sync (or sync --dry-run) to materialize indices and verify that code and blueprint remain in sync without unmapped or uncommitted drift.

claims.statement: CI workflow successfully syncs and passes afwe gate on clean git checkouts
